008package paint.shared.validate;
009
010import java.nio.file.Files;
011import java.nio.file.Path;
012import java.util.List;
013
014import paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo;
015
016import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
017import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.readExperimentInfo;
018
019/**
020 * Validates that all required experiment and image directories exist, and that
021 * each recording flagged for processing in an Experiment Info file has a
022 * corresponding `.nd2` image file in the expected location.
023 */
024public final class ImageRootValidator {
025
026    /**
027     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
028     */
029    private ImageRootValidator() {
030        // Deliberately empty
031    }
032
033
034    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
035    // CORE VALIDATION LOGIC
036    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
037
038    /**
039     * Validates that all required recording image files exist under the specified
040     * image root for each experiment in the provided list.
041     *
042     * <p>For each experiment:
043     * <ul>
044     *   <li>Confirms the corresponding image directory exists under {@code imagesRoot}.</li>
045     *   <li>Confirms the experiment folder under {@code projectRoot} contains
046     *       the {@code Experiment Info.csv} file.</li>
047     *   <li>Loads the Experiment Info table and verifies that each recording
048     *       with {@code Process Flag = true} has a corresponding `.nd2` image.</li>
049     * </ul>
050     *
051     * @param projectRoot     path to the local PAINT project root
052     * @param imagesRoot      path to the global image repository root
053     * @param experimentNames list of experiment identifiers to check
054     * @return a {@link ValidationResult} containing all missing files/directories
055     */
056    public static ValidationResult validateImageRoot(Path projectRoot,
057            Path         imagesRoot,
058            List<String> experimentNames) {
059
060        ValidationResult result = new ValidationResult();
061
062        for (String experiment : experimentNames) {
063            Path experimentDir = projectRoot.resolve(experiment);
064            Path imageDir      = imagesRoot.resolve(experiment);
065
066            // ── 1. Check image directory existence
067            if (!Files.isDirectory(imageDir)) {
068                result.addError("[" + experiment + "] Missing Image Root: " + imageDir);
069                continue;
070            }
071
072            // ── 2. Check Experiment Info CSV presence
073            Path expInfoFile = experimentDir.resolve(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
074            if (!Files.exists(expInfoFile)) {
075                result.addError("[" + experiment + "] Missing " + EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV + " in " + experimentDir);
076                continue;
077            }
078
079            // ── 3. Load Experiment Info using standard reader (handles schema validation + entity conversion)
080            List<ExperimentInfo> rows = readExperimentInfo(experimentDir);
081            if (rows == null) {
082                result.addError("[" + experiment + "] Cannot parse " + EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
083                continue;
084            }
085
086            // ── 4. Validate all ProcessFlag=true recordings by checking that an .nd2 file exists in the corresponding image directory
087            for (ExperimentInfo experimentInfo : rows) {
088                if (experimentInfo.isProcessFlagSet()) {
089                    Path recordingFile = imageDir.resolve(experimentInfo.getRecordingName() + ".nd2");
090                    if (!Files.exists(recordingFile)) {
091                        result.addError("[" + experiment + "] Missing recording file: " + recordingFile);
092                    }
093                }
094            }
095        }
096
097        // ── 5. Generate the summary report
098        if (!result.hasErrors()) {
099            result.setReport("All required image directories and files exist.");
100        } else {
101            result.setReport(String.join("\n", result.getErrors()));
102        }
103
104        return result;
105    }
106}
